description: Pattern: a correction mid-task ("아니, 그게 아니라 …"). The person asks for one thing, the assistant answers a slightly different one, the person corrects what they meant, and the answer must now follow the correction. Pattern taken from the person's real turns (masked, re-worded); the folder is synthetic. Expectations are code checks only.

turns.say: notes/price-list.md 를 읽고 모듈 이름만 알려 줘.
아니, 이름이 아니라 단가를 말한 거야. 단가만 다시 알려 줘.
